transcript: I choose the people, places, and the things in my life wisely. Why? Because my life depends on it. I am not a fly on the wall when it comes to my life. I am fully hands on. I do not allow the external world to present ideas to me and be forced into taking that just because that's what's been presented to me. I will analyze and I will observe and I will get in the mix of all the things because my life requires me to challenge myself. My life requires me to be fully involved. I don't want to not live the life that was created for me. I am fully willing to accept whatever comes my way and maneuver accordingly.
